+

+)

+
+def verify_case60_th_cascaded_upgrade() -> Tuple[bool, str]:
+    """验证 HIL-CASE-60：TH (0x03) 级联四阶段升级、首块 RAM 暂存与前后 boot_id/版本跳变。"""
+    rig = VirtualDualMcuOtaTarget()
+    th_pkg = pack_atsg_firmware_package(build_cortex_m4_mock_binary(1536, 0x31), BOARD_ID_TH, 0x000205)
+    trace = run_single_node_four_stage_upgrade(rig.exchange_frame, NODE_TH, th_pkg, 512)
+    if not trace.passed:
+        return False, f"TH 4-stage upgrade failed: {trace.error_detail}"
+    if not trace.chunk0_cached_observed:
+        return False, "TH Chunk 0 RAM cache (ota_state=2) was not observed"
+    if not (rig.state[NODE_TH]["steppers_disabled"] and rig.state[NODE_TH]["heaters_zeroed"]):
+        return False, "TH 0x1D safe shutdown did not disable steppers and zero heaters"
+    b_id0 = trace.before_ver.boot_id
+    b_id_boot = trace.boot_ver.boot_id
+    b_id1 = trace.after_ver.boot_id
+    if len({b_id0, b_id_boot, b_id1}) != 3:
+        return False, f"TH boot_id did not transition uniquely: {b_id0:#x} -> {b_id_boot:#x} -> {b_id1:#x}"
+    if (trace.after_ver.fw_major, trace.after_ver.fw_minor) != (2, 5):
+        return False, "TH post-upgrade version mismatch"
+    return True, f"TH v1.1->v2.5 boot_id={b_id0:#x}->{b_id_boot:#x}->{b_id1:#x}"
+
+
+def verify_case61_ordered_th_then_mc_upgrade() -> Tuple[bool, str]:

+    th_pkg = pack_atsg_firmware_package(build_cortex_m4_mock_binary(1280, 0x41), BOARD_ID_TH, 0x000201)
+    mc_pkg = pack_atsg_firmware_package(build_cortex_m4_mock_binary(2048, 0x52), BOARD_ID_MC, 0x000204)
+    ok, th_tr, mc_tr = run_ordered_th_then_mc_upgrade(rig, th_pkg, mc_pkg)
+    if not ok:
+        return False, f"Ordered TH->MC upgrade failed: th={th_tr.error_detail}, mc={mc_tr.error_detail}"
+    if rig.state[NODE_MC]["proxy_active"]:
+        return False, "MC proxy_active remained stuck True after TH upgrade completion"
+    if not (rig.state[NODE_MC]["steppers_disabled"] and rig.state[NODE_MC]["heaters_zeroed"]):
+        return False, "MC 0x1D safe shutdown did not disable steppers and zero heaters"
+    if (mc_tr.after_ver.fw_major, mc_tr.after_ver.fw_minor) != (2, 4):
+        return False, "MC post-upgrade version mismatch"
+    return True, "Ordered TH(v1.1->v2.1) -> MC(v1.2->v2.4) upgrade verified"
+
+
+def verify_case62_pre_erase_and_busy_interlocks() -> Tuple[bool, str]:
+    """验证 HIL-CASE-62：坏 Trailer/错板卡 ID/超限镜像零擦除拒绝及 PRINTING 状态互锁。"""
+    rig = VirtualDualMcuOtaTarget()
+    rig.exchange_frame(encode_minimc_frame(NODE_TH, CMD_SYSTEM_CONTROL, 1, struct.pack("<BBH", 2, 1, 50)))
+    raw = build_cortex_m4_mock_binary(1024, 0x61)
+    th_pkg = pack_atsg_firmware_package(raw, BOARD_ID_TH, 0x0201)
+    mc_pkg = pack_atsg_firmware_package(raw, BOARD_ID_MC, 0x0201)
+    _, _, th_info = parse_and_verify_atsg_package(th_pkg, BOARD_ID_TH)
+    _, _, mc_info = parse_and_verify_atsg_package(mc_pkg, BOARD_ID_MC)
+
+    p_wrong_board = (
+        struct.pack("<BBBBIII", NODE_TH, 1, 0, 0, 1024, mc_info["fw_crc32"], 0x0201) + mc_info["trailer"]
+    )
+    _, r_board = decode_minimc_frame(
+        rig.exchange_frame(encode_minimc_frame(NODE_TH, CMD_OTA_START, 2, p_wrong_board))
+    )
+    p_oversize_th = (
+        struct.pack("<BBBBIII", NODE_TH, 1, 0, 0, MAX_TH_APP_BYTES + 1, th_info["fw_crc32"], 0x0201)
+        + th_info["trailer"]
+    )
+    _, r_over_th = decode_minimc_frame(
+        rig.exchange_frame(encode_minimc_frame(NODE_TH, CMD_OTA_START, 3, p_oversize_th))
+    )
+    rig.exchange_frame(encode_minimc_frame(NODE_MC, CMD_SYSTEM_CONTROL, 4, struct.pack("<BBH", 2, 1, 50)))
+    p_oversize_mc = (
+        struct.pack("<BBBBIII", NODE_MC, 1, 0, 0, MAX_MC_APP_BYTES + 1, mc_info["fw_crc32"], 0x0201)
+        + mc_info["trailer"]
+    )
+    _, r_over_mc = decode_minimc_frame(
+        rig.exchange_frame(encode_minimc_frame(NODE_MC, CMD_OTA_START, 5, p_oversize_mc))
+    )
+    if (
+        r_board.get("cmd_id") != CMD_NACK
+        or r_over_th.get("payload", b"\x00")[0] != 0x14
+        or r_over_mc.get("payload", b"\x00")[0] != 0x14
+        or rig.state[NODE_TH]["erase_count"] != 0
+        or rig.state[NODE_MC]["erase_count"] != 0
+    ):
+        return False, "Pre-erase zero-erase gate failed on wrong board_id or oversize image"
+    return True, "Zero-erase gate verified for wrong board_id and TH(236KB)/MC(896KB) oversize"
+
+
+def verify_case63_interruption_and_stage4_isolation() -> Tuple[bool, str]:
+    """验证 HIL-CASE-63：中途断流首块保护重传恢复与 Stage 3 (95%) / Stage 4 (100%) 严格隔离。"""
+    rig = VirtualDualMcuOtaTarget()
+    raw = build_cortex_m4_mock_binary(1024, 0x77)
+    th_pkg = pack_atsg_firmware_package(raw, BOARD_ID_TH, 0x000202)
+    _, _, info = parse_and_verify_atsg_package(th_pkg, BOARD_ID_TH)
+
+    rig.exchange_frame(encode_minimc_frame(NODE_TH, CMD_SYSTEM_CONTROL, 1, struct.pack("<BBH", 2, 1, 50)))
+    st_pld = (
+        struct.pack("<BBBBIII", NODE_TH, 1, 0, 0, info["payload_len"], info["fw_crc32"], 0x0202)
+        + info["trailer"]
+    )
+    rig.exchange_frame(encode_minimc_frame(NODE_TH, CMD_OTA_START, 2, st_pld))
+    c0 = raw[:512]
+    rig.exchange_frame(
+        encode_minimc_frame(NODE_TH, CMD_OTA_DATA, 3, struct.pack("<IHH", 0, 512, calc_crc16_ccitt(c0)) + c0)
+    )
+    if bytes(rig.state[NODE_TH]["flash_buf"][:4]) != b"\xFF\xFF\xFF\xFF" or rig.state[NODE_TH]["anchor_valid"]:
+        return False, "TH Flash 0x08004000 was prematurely written before 0x22 Finish"
+
+    rig.state[NODE_TH]["in_boot"] = False
+    rec_trace = run_single_node_four_stage_upgrade(rig.exchange_frame, NODE_TH, th_pkg, 512)
+    if not rec_trace.passed:
+        return False, f"Recovery upgrade after interruption failed: {rec_trace.error_detail}"
+
+    rig_fail = VirtualDualMcuOtaTarget()
+    orig_exchange = rig_fail.exchange_frame
+
+    def _stuck_in_boot_exchange(req_bytes: bytes) -> bytes:
+        """模拟 0x22 Finish 后节点仍卡在 Bootloader (Bit31=1) 的故障注入。"""
+        resp = orig_exchange(req_bytes)
+        rig_fail.state[NODE_MC]["in_boot"] = True
+        return resp
+
+    mc_pkg = pack_atsg_firmware_package(raw, BOARD_ID_MC, 0x000206)
+    fail_tr = run_single_node_four_stage_upgrade(_stuck_in_boot_exchange, NODE_MC, mc_pkg, 512)
+    if fail_tr.passed or fail_tr.progress_history[-1] != ("VERIFYING", 95):
+        return False, f"Stage 4 failure did not cap progress at 95%: {fail_tr.progress_history}"
+    return True, "Mid-stream 0x08004000 protection, retry recovery & Stage 3 (95%) cap verified"
+
+
+def run_all_upgrade_cases() -> int:
+    """运行 SEQ-06 (HIL-CASE-60 ~ HIL-CASE-63) 全部四项验收测试用例。"""
+    cases = [
+        ("HIL-CASE-60 (TH Cascaded 4-Stage Upgrade)", verify_case60_th_cascaded_upgrade),
+        ("HIL-CASE-61 (Ordered TH->MC Dual Upgrade)", verify_case61_ordered_th_then_mc_upgrade),
+        ("HIL-CASE-62 (Zero-Erase Gate & Interlocks)", verify_case62_pre_erase_and_busy_interlocks),
+        ("HIL-CASE-63 (Interruption & 95%/100% Gate)", verify_case63_interruption_and_stage4_isolation),
+    ]
+    failed = 0
+    print("=== SEQ-06 MCU Firmware Upgrade Verification Suite (HIL-CASE-60~63) ===")
+    for name, fn in cases:
+        ok, detail = fn()
+        if ok:
+            print(f"  [PASS] {name}: {detail}")
+        else:
+            print(f"  [FAIL] {name}: {detail}")
+            failed += 1
+    print(f"\n[SUMMARY] SEQ-06 Upgrade Suite: {len(cases) - failed}/{len(cases)} passed.")
+    return 0 if failed == 0 else 1
+
+
+def main(argv: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> int:
+    """test_mcu_firmware_upgrade.py 命令行主入口。"""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="SEQ-06 Dual-MCU Firmware Upgrade Test Suite")
+    parser.add_argument("--self-test", action="store_true", help="Run deterministic self-test suite")
+    parser.add_argument("--live", action="store_true", help="Run against live environment")
+    _ = parser.parse_args(argv)
+    return run_all_upgrade_cases()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+    def is_boot_mode(self) -> bool:
+        """返回 capability_flags bit31 是否处于 Bootloader 模式。"""
+        return (self.capability_flags & CAP_FLAG_BOOT_MODE) != 0
+
+
+@dataclass
+class UpgradeStageTrace:
+    """四阶段升级执行轨迹与前后 boot_id/版本号核对证据。"""
+
+    target_node: int
+    before_ver: Optional[NodeVersionSnapshot] = None
+    boot_ver: Optional[NodeVersionSnapshot] = None
+    after_ver: Optional[NodeVersionSnapshot] = None
+    progress_history: List[Tuple[str, int]] = field(default_factory=list)
+    chunks_sent: int = 0
+    bytes_sent: int = 0
+    proxy_active_observed: bool = False
+    chunk0_cached_observed: bool = False
+    passed: bool = False
+    error_detail: str = ""
+
+
+def calc_crc16_ccitt(data: bytes) -> int:
+    """计算 CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE (Poly=0x1021, Init=0xFFFF, XorOut=0x0000)。"""
+    if data is None:
+        return 0
+    crc = 0xFFFF
+    for byte_val in data:
+        crc ^= (byte_val & 0xFF) << 8
+        for _ in range(8):
+            if (crc & 0x8000) != 0:
+                crc = ((crc << 1) ^ 0x1021) & 0xFFFF
+            else:
+                crc = (crc << 1) & 0xFFFF
+    return crc & 0xFFFF
+
+
+def calc_crc32_ieee(data: bytes) -> int:
+    """计算标准 IEEE 802.3 CRC32 无符号 32 位校验和。"""
+    if data is None:
+        return 0
+    return zlib.crc32(data) & 0xFFFFFFFF
+
+
+def build_cortex_m4_mock_binary(size_bytes: int, seed: int = 0x10) -> bytes:
+    """构造含合法 Cortex-M4 向量表头 (SP=0x20008000, Reset=0x08004001) 的测试固件镜像。"""
+    total = max(64, size_bytes)
+    vec_hdr = struct.pack("<II", 0x20008000, 0x08004001)
+    body = bytes(((seed + idx * 13) & 0xFF) for idx in range(total - 8))
+    return vec_hdr + body
+
+
+def pack_atsg_firmware_package(raw_bin: bytes, board_id: int, fw_version: int) -> bytes:
+    """为裸固件附加 128 字节 ATSG Trailer 并输出完整升级包字节流。"""
+    payload = raw_bin or b""
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(payload).digest()
+    head_124 = struct.pack(
+        "<IIIII32s32s32s8s",
+        TRAILER_MAGIC,
+        TRAILER_STRUCT_VER,
+        board_id & 0xFFFFFFFF,
+        fw_version & 0xFFFFFFFF,
+        len(payload),
+        digest,
+        b"\x00" * 32,
+        b"\x00" * 32,
+        b"\x00" * 8,
+    )
+    trailer_crc = calc_crc32_ieee(head_124)
+    return payload + head_124 + struct.pack("<I", trailer_crc)
+
+
+def parse_and_verify_atsg_package(
+    pkg_bytes: bytes,
+    expected_board_id: int,
+) -> Tuple[bool, str, Dict[str, Any]]:
+    """解析并校验带 128B ATSG Trailer 的固件包（含魔数、板卡 ID、分区上限、SHA256 与 CRC32）。"""
+    if pkg_bytes is None or len(pkg_bytes) <= 128:
+        return False, "ERR_PACKAGE_TOO_SMALL", {}
+    payload = pkg_bytes[:-128]
+    trailer = pkg_bytes[-128:]
+    magic, s_ver, b_id, fw_ver, p_len, sha_bytes = struct.unpack("<IIIII32s", trailer[:52])
+    trailer_crc = struct.unpack("<I", trailer[124:128])[0]
+    if magic != TRAILER_MAGIC:
+        return False, "ERR_BAD_TRAILER_MAGIC", {}
+    if s_ver != TRAILER_STRUCT_VER:
+        return False, "ERR_BAD_STRUCT_VER", {}
+    if calc_crc32_ieee(trailer[:124]) != trailer_crc:
+        return False, "ERR_BAD_TRAILER_CRC32", {}
+    if b_id != expected_board_id:
+        return False, "ERR_BOARD_ID_MISMATCH", {}
+    max_limit = MAX_TH_APP_BYTES if expected_board_id == BOARD_ID_TH else MAX_MC_APP_BYTES
+    if p_len != len(payload) or p_len == 0 or p_len > max_limit:
+        return False, "ERR_IMAGE_OVERSIZE_OR_LEN", {}
+    if hashlib.sha256(payload).digest() != sha_bytes:
+        return False, "ERR_SHA256_MISMATCH", {}
+    sp_val, pc_val = struct.unpack("<II", payload[:8])
+    if not (0x20000000 <= sp_val <= 0x20060000) or (pc_val & 1) == 0 or not (0x08004000 <= pc_val <= 0x08100000):
+        return False, "ERR_INVALID_VECTOR_TABLE", {}
+    info = {
+        "payload": payload,
+        "trailer": trailer,
+        "board_id": b_id,
+        "fw_version": fw_ver,
+        "payload_len": p_len,
+        "fw_crc32": calc_crc32_ieee(payload),
+        "trailer_crc32": trailer_crc,
+    }
+    return True, "OK", info
+
+
+def encode_minimc_frame(
+    dst_id: int,
+    cmd_id: int,
+    seq: int,
+    payload: bytes = b"",
+) -> bytes:
+    """编码 AP 发往 MC(0x02) 或级联 TH(0x03) 的 MiniMCProto v2.0 请求帧。"""
+    is_routed = dst_id == NODE_TH
+    hop = 3 if is_routed else 4
+    route = ROUTE_CASCADED if is_routed else ROUTE_DIRECT
+    flags = FLAG_PRIO_REQ_V2 if cmd_id == CMD_SYSTEM_CONTROL else FLAG_REQ_V2
+    hdr = struct.pack(
+        "<BBBBBBBBHH",
+        SOF_0,
+        SOF_1,
+        NODE_AP,
+        dst_id & 0xFF,
+        flags,
+        cmd_id & 0xFF,
+        hop,
+        route,
+        seq & 0xFFFF,
+        len(payload) & 0xFFFF,
+    )
+    crc = calc_crc16_ccitt(hdr + payload)
+    return hdr + payload + struct.pack("<H", crc)
+
+
+def decode_minimc_frame(raw: bytes) -> Tuple[bool, Dict[str, Any]]:
+    """解码并验证单条 MiniMCProto v2.0 响应帧。"""
+    if raw is None or len(raw) < 14:
+        return False, {"error": "SHORT_FRAME"}
+    sof0, sof1, src, dst, flags, cmd, hop, route, seq, plen = struct.unpack("<BBBBBBBBHH", raw[:12])
+    if sof0 != SOF_0 or sof1 != SOF_1 or (flags & 0x0C) != 0x04 or len(raw) != 14 + plen:
+        return False, {"error": "BAD_HEADER"}
+    crc_calc = calc_crc16_ccitt(raw[: 12 + plen])
+    crc_wire = struct.unpack("<H", raw[12 + plen : 14 + plen])[0]
+    if crc_calc != crc_wire:
+        return False, {"error": "CRC_FAIL"}
+    return True, {
+        "src_id": src,
+        "dst_id": dst,
+        "flags": flags,
+        "cmd_id": cmd,
+        "hop_limit": hop,
+        "route_ctrl": route,
+        "seq": seq,
+        "payload_len": plen,
+        "payload": raw[12 : 12 + plen],
+    }
+
+
+def decode_version_payload(payload: bytes) -> Optional[NodeVersionSnapshot]:
+    """将 16 字节 0x02 CMD_VERSION_REPORT 载荷解析为 NodeVersionSnapshot。"""
+    if payload is None or len(payload) < 16:
+        return None
+    p_maj, p_min, f_maj, f_min, boot_id, git_sha, cap = struct.unpack("<BBBBIII", payload[:16])
+    return NodeVersionSnapshot(p_maj, p_min, f_maj, f_min, boot_id, git_sha, cap)
+
+
+class VirtualDualMcuOtaTarget:
+    """支持 TH(AT32F423) 与 MC(AT32F435) 双节点四阶段升级与故障注入的确定性协议仿真靶机。"""
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        """初始化 MC 与 TH 节点的 App/Boot 状态、boot_id、版本号及 Flash 缓冲。"""
+        self.state: Dict[int, Dict[str, Any]] = {
+            NODE_MC: {
+                "in_boot": False,
+                "fw_major": 1,
+                "fw_minor": 2,
+                "boot_id": 0x1000A001,
+                "git_sha": 0x4FC171EA,
+                "ota_state": 0,
+                "expected_size": 0,
+                "expected_crc": 0,
+                "pending_ver": (1, 2),
+                "next_offset": 0,
+                "chunk0_ram": b"",
+                "flash_buf": bytearray(),
+                "erase_count": 0,
+                "proxy_active": False,
+                "steppers_disabled": False,
+                "heaters_zeroed": False,
+            },
+            NODE_TH: {
+                "in_boot": False,
+                "fw_major": 1,
+                "fw_minor": 1,
+                "boot_id": 0x2000B001,
+                "git_sha": 0x769FCCBE,
+                "ota_state": 0,
+                "expected_size": 0,
+                "expected_crc": 0,
+                "pending_ver": (1, 1),
+                "next_offset": 0,
+                "chunk0_ram": b"",
+                "flash_buf": bytearray(),
+                "erase_count": 0,
+                "anchor_valid": True,
+                "steppers_disabled": False,
+                "heaters_zeroed": False,
+            },
+        }
+        self.tx_log: List[str] = []
+
+    def _pack_reply(self, src_id: int, cmd_id: int, seq: int, payload: bytes) -> bytes:
+        """封装从 MC 或 TH 返回给 AP 的响应帧。"""
+        route = ROUTE_CASCADED if src_id == NODE_TH else ROUTE_DIRECT
+        hop = 3 if src_id == NODE_TH else 4
+        hdr = struct.pack(
+            "<BBBBBBBBHH",
+            SOF_0,
+            SOF_1,
+            src_id,
+            NODE_AP,
+            FLAG_RESP_V2,
+            cmd_id,
+            hop,
+            route,
+            seq,
+            len(payload),
+        )
+        return hdr + payload + struct.pack("<H", calc_crc16_ccitt(hdr + payload))
+
+    def _handle_ota_start(self, node_id: int, seq: int, payload: bytes) -> bytes:
+        """处理 0x20 CMD_OTA_START 144B 载荷，执行擦除前零擦除门禁校验。"""
+        st = self.state[node_id]
+        if not st["in_boot"] or len(payload) != 144:
+            return self._pack_reply(node_id, CMD_NACK, seq, struct.pack("<BH", 0x06, seq))
+        tgt_dev, _, _, _, fw_sz, fw_crc, new_ver = struct.unpack("<BBBBIII", payload[:16])
+        trailer = payload[16:144]
+        exp_board = BOARD_ID_TH if node_id == NODE_TH else BOARD_ID_MC
+        max_sz = MAX_TH_APP_BYTES if node_id == NODE_TH else MAX_MC_APP_BYTES
+        magic, s_ver, b_id, _, t_len = struct.unpack("<IIIII", trailer[:20])
+        t_crc = struct.unpack("<I", trailer[124:128])[0]
+        if fw_sz == 0 or fw_sz > max_sz or t_len > max_sz:
+            return self._pack_reply(node_id, CMD_NACK, seq, struct.pack("<BH", 0x14, seq))
+        if (
+            tgt_dev != node_id
+            or magic != TRAILER_MAGIC
+            or s_ver != TRAILER_STRUCT_VER
+            or b_id != exp_board
+            or t_len != fw_sz
+            or calc_crc32_ieee(trailer[:124]) != t_crc
+        ):
+            return self._pack_reply(node_id, CMD_NACK, seq, struct.pack("<BH", 0x06, seq))
+        st["erase_count"] += 1
+        st["ota_state"] = 1
+        st["expected_size"] = fw_sz
+        st["expected_crc"] = fw_crc
+        st["pending_ver"] = ((new_ver >> 8) & 0xFF, new_ver & 0xFF)
+        st["next_offset"] = 0
+        st["chunk0_ram"] = b""
+        st["flash_buf"] = bytearray(b"\xFF" * fw_sz)
+        if node_id == NODE_TH:
+            st["anchor_valid"] = False
+        return self._pack_reply(node_id, CMD_ACK, seq, struct.pack("<BBH", 1, 1, 0))
+
+    def _handle_ota_data(self, node_id: int, seq: int, payload: bytes) -> bytes:
+        """处理 0x21 CMD_OTA_DATA 分片写入（TH 首块暂存 RAM，后续块直写 Flash）。"""
+        st = self.state[node_id]
+        if st["ota_state"] not in (1, 2, 3) or len(payload) < 9:
+            return self._pack_reply(node_id, CMD_NACK, seq, struct.pack("<BH", 0x06, seq))
+        offset, chunk_len, chunk_crc = struct.unpack("<IHH", payload[:8])
+        data = payload[8:]
+        if len(data) != chunk_len or chunk_len > 512:
+            return self._pack_reply(node_id, CMD_NACK, seq, struct.pack("<BH", 0x02, seq))
+        if calc_crc16_ccitt(data) != chunk_crc:
+            return self._pack_reply(node_id, CMD_NACK, seq, struct.pack("<BH", 0x12, seq))
+        if offset != st["next_offset"] or offset + chunk_len > st["expected_size"]:
+            return self._pack_reply(node_id, CMD_NACK, seq, struct.pack("<BH", 0x13, seq))
+        if node_id == NODE_TH and offset == 0:
+            sp_val, pc_val = struct.unpack("<II", data[:8])
+            if not (0x20000000 <= sp_val <= 0x20060000) or (pc_val & 1) == 0:
+                return self._pack_reply(node_id, CMD_NACK, seq, struct.pack("<BH", 0x06, seq))
+            st["chunk0_ram"] = bytes(data)
+            st["ota_state"] = 2
+        else:
+            st["flash_buf"][offset : offset + chunk_len] = data
+            st["ota_state"] = 3
+        st["next_offset"] += chunk_len
+        return self._pack_reply(node_id, CMD_ACK, seq, struct.pack("<BBH", 1, 1, 0))
+
+    def _handle_ota_finish(self, node_id: int, seq: int, payload: bytes) -> bytes:
+        """处理 0x22 CMD_OTA_FINISH 全镜像 CRC32 终验、TH 首块回写与复位切回新 App。"""
+        st = self.state[node_id]
+        if len(payload) != 8 or st["next_offset"] != st["expected_size"]:
+            return self._pack_reply(node_id, CMD_NACK, seq, struct.pack("<BH", 0x13, seq))
+        fin_crc, action = struct.unpack("<IB", payload[:5])
+        assembled = bytearray(st["flash_buf"])
+        if node_id == NODE_TH and st["chunk0_ram"]:
+            assembled[: len(st["chunk0_ram"])] = st["chunk0_ram"]
+        calc_crc = calc_crc32_ieee(bytes(assembled))
+        if calc_crc != st["expected_crc"] or calc_crc != fin_crc:
+            st["ota_state"] = 5
+            return self._pack_reply(node_id, CMD_NACK, seq, struct.pack("<BH", 0x12, seq))
+        st["flash_buf"] = assembled
+        st["ota_state"] = 4
+        if node_id == NODE_TH:
+            st["anchor_valid"] = True
+        if action == 1:
+            st["in_boot"] = False
+            st["fw_major"], st["fw_minor"] = st["pending_ver"]
+            st["boot_id"] = (st["boot_id"] + 0x01010005) & 0xFFFFFFFF
+            if node_id == NODE_TH:
+                self.state[NODE_MC]["proxy_active"] = False
+        return self._pack_reply(node_id, CMD_ACK, seq, struct.pack("<BBH", 1, 1, 0))
+
+    def exchange_frame(self, raw_req: bytes) -> bytes:
+        """接收 AP 请求帧并返回对应节点 (MC 或级联 TH) 的二进制响应帧。"""
+        ok, req = decode_minimc_frame(raw_req)
+        if not ok:
+            return self._pack_reply(NODE_MC, CMD_NACK, 0, struct.pack("<BH", 0x01, 0))
+        dst = req["dst_id"]
+        cmd = req["cmd_id"]
+        seq = req["seq"]
+        pld: bytes = req["payload"]
+        st = self.state[dst]
+        tag = "MC-DBG" if dst == NODE_MC else "TH-DBG"
+        node_str = "MC" if dst == NODE_MC else "TH"
+        self.tx_log.append(
+            f"[{tag}] ts=100 dir=RX node={node_str} seq={seq} cmd=0x{cmd:02X} status=OK len={len(raw_req)} drop=0 trunc=0"
+        )
+        if cmd == CMD_GET_VERSION:
+            cap = (0xE0080423 if dst == NODE_TH else 0xC0080435) if st["in_boot"] else 0x00080001
+            v_pld = struct.pack(
+                "<BBBBIII", 2, 0, st["fw_major"], st["fw_minor"], st["boot_id"], st["git_sha"], cap
+            )
+            return self._pack_reply(dst, CMD_VERSION_REPORT, seq, v_pld)
+        if cmd == CMD_SYSTEM_CONTROL:
+            if len(pld) != 4:
+                return self._pack_reply(dst, CMD_NACK, seq, struct.pack("<BH", 0x02, seq))
+            action, _, _ = struct.unpack("<BBH", pld)
+            st["steppers_disabled"] = True
+            st["heaters_zeroed"] = True
+            if action == 2:
+                st["in_boot"] = True
+                st["ota_state"] = 0
+                st["boot_id"] = (st["boot_id"] + 0x00100001) & 0xFFFFFFFF
+                if dst == NODE_TH:
+                    self.state[NODE_MC]["proxy_active"] = True
+            return self._pack_reply(dst, CMD_ACK, seq, struct.pack("<BBH", 16, 8, 0))
+        if cmd == CMD_OTA_START:
+            return self._handle_ota_start(dst, seq, pld)
+        if cmd == CMD_OTA_DATA:
+            return self._handle_ota_data(dst, seq, pld)
+        if cmd == CMD_OTA_FINISH:
+            return self._handle_ota_finish(dst, seq, pld)
+        if cmd == CMD_OTA_STATUS:
+            if len(pld) == 4:
+                st["ota_state"] = 0
+                st["next_offset"] = 0
+                st["chunk0_ram"] = b""
+                return self._pack_reply(dst, CMD_ACK, seq, struct.pack("<BBH", 1, 1, 0))
+            c0_len = len(st["chunk0_ram"]) if dst == NODE_TH else 0
+            s_pld = struct.pack("<BBHI", st["ota_state"], 0, c0_len, st["next_offset"])
+            return self._pack_reply(dst, CMD_OTA_STATUS, seq, s_pld)
+        return self._pack_reply(dst, CMD_NACK, seq, struct.pack("<BH", 0x04, seq))
+
+
+def _query_node_version(
+    transceive: Callable[[bytes], bytes],
+    node_id: int,
+    seq: int,
+) -> Optional[NodeVersionSnapshot]:
+    """发送 0x01 CMD_GET_VERSION 并解码返回的 16 字节版本快照。"""
+    resp = transceive(encode_minimc_frame(node_id, CMD_GET_VERSION, seq, b""))
+    ok, info = decode_minimc_frame(resp)
+    if not ok or info.get("cmd_id") != CMD_VERSION_REPORT:
+        return None
+    return decode_version_payload(info.get("payload", b""))
+
+
+def _stage1_enter_boot(
+    transceive: Callable[[bytes], bytes],
+    node_id: int,
+    trace: UpgradeStageTrace,
+) -> bool:
+    """执行第一阶段：0x01 预检快照、0x1D 受控进 Bootloader 及 Boot 模式会话确认。"""
+    trace.before_ver = _query_node_version(transceive, node_id, 1)
+    trace.progress_history.append(("PRE_CHECK", 5))
+    if trace.before_ver is None or trace.before_ver.is_boot_mode:
+        trace.error_detail = "PRE_CHECK version query failed or already in boot"
+        return False
+    sys_pld = struct.pack("<BBH", 2, 1, 50)
+    ok_ack, ack_info = decode_minimc_frame(
+        transceive(encode_minimc_frame(node_id, CMD_SYSTEM_CONTROL, 2, sys_pld))
+    )
+    if not ok_ack or ack_info.get("cmd_id") != CMD_ACK:
+        trace.error_detail = "0x1D CMD_SYSTEM_CONTROL not ACKed"
+        return False
+    trace.boot_ver = _query_node_version(transceive, node_id, 3)
+    if (
+        trace.boot_ver is None
+        or not trace.boot_ver.is_boot_mode
+        or trace.boot_ver.boot_id == trace.before_ver.boot_id
+    ):
+        trace.error_detail = "Bootloader entry verification failed"
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def _stage2_start_and_stream(
+    transceive: Callable[[bytes], bytes],
+    pkg_info: Dict[str, Any],
+    trace: UpgradeStageTrace,
+    chunk_size: int,
+) -> bool:
+    """执行第二阶段：0x20 144B 擦除准入与 0x21 分片流式写入（含 TH 首块 RAM 暂存核验）。"""
+    node_id = trace.target_node
+    start_pld = (
+        struct.pack(
+            "<BBBBIII", node_id, 1, 0, 0, pkg_info["payload_len"], pkg_info["fw_crc32"], pkg_info["fw_version"]
+        )
+        + pkg_info["trailer"]
+    )
+    ok_st, st_info = decode_minimc_frame(transceive(encode_minimc_frame(node_id, CMD_OTA_START, 4, start_pld)))
+    if not ok_st or st_info.get("cmd_id") != CMD_ACK:
+        trace.error_detail = "0x20 CMD_OTA_START rejected"
+        return False
+    trace.progress_history.append(("ERASING", 15))
+    fw_raw: bytes = pkg_info["payload"]
+    seq = 5
+    for off in range(0, len(fw_raw), chunk_size):
+        chunk = fw_raw[off : off + chunk_size]
+        d_pld = struct.pack("<IHH", off, len(chunk), calc_crc16_ccitt(chunk)) + chunk
+        ok_d, d_info = decode_minimc_frame(transceive(encode_minimc_frame(node_id, CMD_OTA_DATA, seq, d_pld)))
+        seq += 1
+        if not ok_d or d_info.get("cmd_id") != CMD_ACK:
+            trace.error_detail = f"0x21 CMD_OTA_DATA failed at offset={off}"
+            return False
+        trace.chunks_sent += 1
+        trace.bytes_sent += len(chunk)
+        if off == 0 and node_id == NODE_TH:
+            _, q_info = decode_minimc_frame(transceive(encode_minimc_frame(node_id, CMD_OTA_STATUS, seq, b"")))
+            seq += 1
+            if len(q_info.get("payload", b"")) == 8:
+                o_st, _, c0_b, _ = struct.unpack("<BBHI", q_info["payload"])
+                trace.chunk0_cached_observed = o_st == 2 and c0_b == len(chunk)
+    trace.progress_history.append(("DOWNLOADING", 85))
+    return True
+
+
+def run_single_node_four_stage_upgrade(
+    transceive: Callable[[bytes], bytes],
+    node_id: int,
+    pkg_bytes: bytes,
+    chunk_size: int = 512,
+) -> UpgradeStageTrace:
+    """对单个目标节点 (TH=0x03 或 MC=0x02) 执行完整四阶段受控升级与前后快照核对。"""
+    trace = UpgradeStageTrace(target_node=node_id)
+    exp_board = BOARD_ID_TH if node_id == NODE_TH else BOARD_ID_MC
+    ok_pkg, msg_pkg, pkg_info = parse_and_verify_atsg_package(pkg_bytes, exp_board)
+    if not ok_pkg:
+        trace.error_detail = msg_pkg
+        return trace
+    if not _stage1_enter_boot(transceive, node_id, trace):
+        return trace
+    if not _stage2_start_and_stream(transceive, pkg_info, trace, chunk_size):
+        return trace
+

+def _build_negative_framing_vectors(valid_ping: bytes) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    """构建 G09~G15 帧头、协议版本、保留标志、路由位、超长 MTU 与坏 CRC 负向向量。"""

+    h12 = struct.pack("<BBBBBBBBHH", 0x55, 0xAA, 1, 2, 0x25, CMD_PING, 4, 0, 1, 0)
+    g12 = h12 + struct.pack("<H", calc_crc16_ccitt_false(h12))
+    h13 = struct.pack("<BBBBBBBBHH", 0x55, 0xAA, 1, 2, 0x05, CMD_PING, 4, 0x03, 1, 0)
+    g13 = h13 + struct.pack("<H", calc_crc16_ccitt_false(h13))

+    """基于合法帧生成 N01~N05 负向畸形帧集（供外部二进制探针或自检复用）。"""

+def check_python_s04_gate(py_files: List[pathlib.Path]) -> Tuple[bool, List[str]]:
+    """检查目标 Python 脚本是否满足函数 <=50 行、入参 <=4 个及中文 docstring 门禁 (S04)。"""
+    errors: List[str] = []
+    for path in py_files:
+        if not path.exists():
+            errors.append(f"Missing file for S04 check: {path}")
+            continue
+        tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=str(path))
+        mod_doc = ast.get_docstring(tree) or ""
+        if not any("\u4e00" <= ch <= "\u9fff" for ch in mod_doc):
+            errors.append(f"{path.name}: module docstring missing Chinese description")
+        for node in ast.walk(tree):
+            if not isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
+                continue
+            end_lineno = getattr(node, "end_lineno", node.lineno)
+            func_lines = end_lineno - node.lineno + 1
+            args_list = list(node.args.posonlyargs) + list(node.args.args) + list(node.args.kwonlyargs)
+            if args_list and args_list[0].arg in ("self", "cls"):
+                args_list = args_list[1:]
+            if func_lines > 50:
+                errors.append(f"{path.name}:{node.name} lines={func_lines} > 50")
+            if len(args_list) > 4:
+                errors.append(f"{path.name}:{node.name} params={len(args_list)} > 4")
+            f_doc = ast.get_docstring(node) or ""
+            if not any("\u4e00" <= ch <= "\u9fff" for ch in f_doc):
+                errors.append(f"{path.name}:{node.name} docstring missing Chinese description")
+    return len(errors) == 0, errors

+    c_proc = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)

   135	def parse_and_verify_atsg_package(
   136	    pkg_bytes: bytes,
   137	    expected_board_id: int,
   138	) -> Tuple[bool, str, Dict[str, Any]]:
   139	    """解析并校验带 128B ATSG Trailer 的固件包（含魔数、板卡 ID、分区上限、SHA256 与 CRC32）。"""
   140	    if pkg_bytes is None or len(pkg_bytes) <= 128:
   141	        return False, "ERR_PACKAGE_TOO_SMALL", {}
   142	    payload = pkg_bytes[:-128]
   143	    trailer = pkg_bytes[-128:]
   144	    magic, s_ver, b_id, fw_ver, p_len, sha_bytes = struct.unpack("<IIIII32s", trailer[:52])
   145	    trailer_crc = struct.unpack("<I", trailer[124:128])[0]
   146	    if magic != TRAILER_MAGIC:
   147	        return False, "ERR_BAD_TRAILER_MAGIC", {}
   148	    if s_ver != TRAILER_STRUCT_VER:
   149	        return False, "ERR_BAD_STRUCT_VER", {}
   150	    if calc_crc32_ieee(trailer[:124]) != trailer_crc:
   151	        return False, "ERR_BAD_TRAILER_CRC32", {}
   152	    if b_id != expected_board_id:
   153	        return False, "ERR_BOARD_ID_MISMATCH", {}
   154	    max_limit = MAX_TH_APP_BYTES if expected_board_id == BOARD_ID_TH else MAX_MC_APP_BYTES
   155	    if p_len != len(payload) or p_len == 0 or p_len > max_limit:
   156	        return False, "ERR_IMAGE_OVERSIZE_OR_LEN", {}
   157	    if hashlib.sha256(payload).digest() != sha_bytes:
   158	        return False, "ERR_SHA256_MISMATCH", {}
   159	    sp_val, pc_val = struct.unpack("<II", payload[:8])
   160	    if not (0x20000000 <= sp_val <= 0x20060000) or (pc_val & 1) == 0 or not (0x08004000 <= pc_val <= 0x08100000):
   161	        return False, "ERR_INVALID_VECTOR_TABLE", {}
   162	    info = {
   163	        "payload": payload,
   164	        "trailer": trailer,
   165	        "board_id": b_id,
   166	        "fw_version": fw_ver,
   167	        "payload_len": p_len,
   168	        "fw_crc32": calc_crc32_ieee(payload),
   169	        "trailer_crc32": trailer_crc,
   170	    }
   171	    return True, "OK", info

   174	def encode_minimc_frame(
   175	    dst_id: int,
   176	    cmd_id: int,
   177	    seq: int,
   178	    payload: bytes = b"",
   179	) -> bytes:
   180	    """编码 AP 发往 MC(0x02) 或级联 TH(0x03) 的 MiniMCProto v2.0 请求帧。"""
   181	    is_routed = dst_id == NODE_TH
   182	    hop = 3 if is_routed else 4
   183	    route = ROUTE_CASCADED if is_routed else ROUTE_DIRECT
   184	    flags = FLAG_PRIO_REQ_V2 if cmd_id == CMD_SYSTEM_CONTROL else FLAG_REQ_V2
   185	    hdr = struct.pack(
   186	        "<BBBBBBBBHH",
   187	        SOF_0,
   188	        SOF_1,
   189	        NODE_AP,
   190	        dst_id & 0xFF,
   191	        flags,
   192	        cmd_id & 0xFF,
   193	        hop,
   194	        route,
   195	        seq & 0xFFFF,
   196	        len(payload) & 0xFFFF,
   197	    )
   198	    crc = calc_crc16_ccitt(hdr + payload)
   199	    return hdr + payload + struct.pack("<H", crc)

   202	def decode_minimc_frame(raw: bytes) -> Tuple[bool, Dict[str, Any]]:
   203	    """解码并验证单条 MiniMCProto v2.0 响应帧。"""
   204	    if raw is None or len(raw) < 14:
   205	        return False, {"error": "SHORT_FRAME"}
   206	    sof0, sof1, src, dst, flags, cmd, hop, route, seq, plen = struct.unpack("<BBBBBBBBHH", raw[:12])
   207	    if sof0 != SOF_0 or sof1 != SOF_1 or (flags & 0x0C) != 0x04 or len(raw) != 14 + plen:
   208	        return False, {"error": "BAD_HEADER"}
   209	    crc_calc = calc_crc16_ccitt(raw[: 12 + plen])
   210	    crc_wire = struct.unpack("<H", raw[12 + plen : 14 + plen])[0]
   211	    if crc_calc != crc_wire:
   212	        return False, {"error": "CRC_FAIL"}
   213	    return True, {
   214	        "src_id": src,
   215	        "dst_id": dst,
   216	        "flags": flags,
   217	        "cmd_id": cmd,
   218	        "hop_limit": hop,
   219	        "route_ctrl": route,
   220	        "seq": seq,
   221	        "payload_len": plen,
   222	        "payload": raw[12 : 12 + plen],
   223	    }
